svg.text: Real-Time AML & Fraud Detection Funnel
RBI FREE-AI Governance & Math
Layered defense balancing sub-50ms payment throughput with base rate fallacy containment
1. Payment Streaming Ingress (40M tx/day)
Real-time UPI/IMPS switch · Sub-50ms strict latency SLA budget
2. Fast Velocity & Device Filter (99.5% Pass)
Rules engine, blacklist, geofence, device fingerprint (latency < 15ms)
3. GNN & Mule Ring Detector (0.5%)
200k tx/day · Cyclic flows, mule clusters, rapid cash layering
4. Calibrated High-Recall ML (0.05%)
20k alerts/day · Asymmetric cost matrix filtering
5. GenAI STR Dossier
Top 200 High-Priority Cases/Day
Drafts FIU-IND STR · Human Sign-off
A. Base Rate Fallacy Containment
Prevalence p(Fraud) = 0.01%. An uncalibrated 99%
accurate model yields 98% false alerts! Asymmetric loss
matrix and threshold tuning ensure investigator ROI.
B. Graph Topology & Mule Networks
Sub-50ms graph traversal identifies cyclic rings, dynamic
entity resolution across SIM/UPI IDs, and rapid liquidity
drainage (₹50k routed to 20 mules and cashed in <120s).
C. Mandatory PMLA Statutory Sign-Off
Under Indian PMLA, algorithms cannot file statutory
STRs unattended. Principal Officer reviews synthesized
narrative dossier and carries personal legal accountability.
The RBI FREE-AI Governance Contract
• Fairness: Zero demographic or regional bias in account freezes
• Resilience: Circuit breakers for model drift & false-cascade cascades
• Explainability: Visual subgraph audit trail for every STR filed
DPDP Act compliance: sovereign on-prem financial data custody
